identity: ONE original young woman crossbow soldier, the Prism Adept, facing screen right in elevated three-quarter view. Keep her ivory hood with blue lining, the long dark hair, the gold-edged white and royal blue split tabard with a gold sun star, the dark leggings, the gold boots, the gold and blue gloves, the iridescent blue-gold crystal shoulder plates and the crystal bolt pouch at the screen-left hip. Exactly two arms, two hands and two legs. Both hands hold ONE rigid elaborate gold and blue crystal crossbow diagonally across her waist, pointing to screen right, with curved bow limbs, a thin string, a central blue gem and a crystal muzzle. Preserve the crossbow, the hood and the slim proportions.
plate: Locked orthographic camera, fixed anatomical scale and centred body. Keep the full hood, the whole crossbow, the tabard tails, limbs and boots within frame. The background is perfectly flat saturated GREEN throughout, no gradients or changes of hue. The green background stays the same flat saturated green in every frame and never darkens, flashes or changes colour. No scenery, floor shadow, camera motion, zoom, bolts in flight, muzzle flash, glow bursts, sparks, motion trails, particles or extra limbs. Articulate joints naturally with physical planted-foot support; the crossbow stays rigid and never morphs.

idle_h3_v1.action: A calm, alert idle that loops. She breathes, the shoulders rise and fall, the crossbow dips a little and lifts as she resettles her grip, her head turns slightly to scan and the tabard tails stir, then everything returns smoothly to the original stance. Both boots stay planted. No walking and no shooting.

attack_h3_v1.action: Make ONE crossbow bash toward screen right. She draws the crossbow back to her shoulder as the knees bend, then lunges forward and drives the crystal muzzle out to full reach at screen right with both hands, draws back and settles into the original stance. One bash only; nothing is fired and no effect appears at contact.

ranged_h3_v1.action: Shoot ONE bolt toward screen right. She raises the crossbow to her shoulder and sights along it toward screen right, holds the aim, then the string snaps forward and the crossbow kicks up, holds a moment, then she lowers it across her waist in the original stance. One shot only; the bolt is never shown in flight, with no flash, glow or trail.

hit_h3_v1.action: She starts rocked back in a flinch and recovers from it. Her head and shoulders are thrown back, the hood and tabard swing and the knees flex while both hands keep hold of the crossbow, then she steadies on both boots and returns to the same stance. Only the body moves; nothing else appears in the frame.

defend_h3_v1.action: Crouch low and brace the crossbow crosswise in front of the body with both hands as a guard, the hooded head lowered behind it, then hold the braced guard on both planted boots. No shooting and no return to the relaxed stance.

cast_h3_v1.action: A brief salute. She bows her hooded head and draws the crossbow close against her chest, holds the bow briefly, then straightens back to the original stance. A physical gesture only: no spell, glow or aura.
